The other two new raises redact (the fast-path probe at line 3261 and the shallow clone at line 3303).
  WHY: Nothing leaks in production today because the only caller, the lambda at line 3648 inside `_run_memory_read_with_retry`, redacts before its final raise. It still breaks "never appear in a raised message", and the new test relies on redaction at the source. Suggested fix: `f"stderr:\n{_redact_memory_push_stderr(heads_probe.stderr or heads_probe.stdout or '')}"` (`_redact_memory_push_stderr` is defined at line 3529 and resolved at call time).

  WHY: The token-URL probe returns (0, "", ""). The in-clone `ls-remote --heads origin ai-memory` returns 128 with BARE_403_STDERR. The raise at 3332-3335 embeds it raw, and `_clone_for_memory_branch` re-raises it at 3316-3318 without redacting, so the assertion fails and the tests-system-python catch-all job on head 59409e41 cannot go green. After the fix, the redacted text still contains "returned error: 403" and still counts as transient.
